name: Triggers
description: A scheduler of record over the SQL storage adapter: job rows, a lease with a claim token, runs, missed runs and their rule, pause, resume, a hand run, bounded retries and a failed state, a stall watcher, reports-only jobs and an audit hook, with migrations on PostgreSQL and SQLite.

extensions.description: A scheduler of record over the storage adapter: definitions registered in code, a lease in the store, runs and missed runs, pause, resume and a hand run, retries and a failed state, a stall watcher

features: Three tables under a prefix of the product's own, with migrations on PostgreSQL and SQLite, applied through the adapter's runSchemaMigrations under the product's lock
Schedules of three kinds, at, every and cron (five fields, UTC), with a hardened parser and next-match by epoch arithmetic
One run per due time across processes: a lease claimed in one statement with a token new for each claim, renewed each tick while the run is pending, and a settlement fenced by the token
A missed-run rule a schedule (catch up once, skip, required) applied at start and at resume, each missed due time recorded
Bounded retries with backoff, a failed state that pauses the job for a person, and a hand run for a job marked safe to run twice
A stall watcher for a process that runs no jobs, under its own lease row, that opens one record a stall and closes it when the job runs again
Reports-only rows for jobs that run on their own timer and report their beats here
